profile.name: AMI超导磁体持久电流开关系统
profile.name_en: AMI superconducting magnet with persistent current switch
profile.description: 这是一套用于低温实验的超导磁体系统，配有持久电流开关和外部电流源控制。它可将目标磁场换算为励磁电流，对磁体进行升降场，并在持久模式下维持稳定磁场，常用于量子器件、纳米器件和低温输运测量中的磁场施加与保持。
profile.description_en: This is a superconducting magnet system for cryogenic experiments, equipped with a persistent current switch and controlled by an external current source. It converts target magnetic field values into drive currents, ramps the magnet field, and maintains a stable field in persistent mode. It is commonly used for applying and holding magnetic fields in quantum-device, nanodevice, and low-temperature transport measurements.
